---
title: "A widget from knitr"
format:
  emiljs:
    keep-emiljs: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      # prefer-html is on by default, so widgets are not an error; the
      # dependency's script is written into the deck and resolves from <stem>_files
      postRenderCleanup: ['${input_stem}.commonmark_x_files']
      noErrorsOrWarnings: []
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['#widget-target', 'script[src*="libs/widgetdep-1.0/dep.js"]']
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        - ['```\{=html\}\n.*<script src="[^"]*libs/widgetdep-1.0/dep.js">']
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$div(id = "widget-target", "before"),
  htmltools::htmlDependency(
    "widgetdep", "1.0",
    src = c(file = normalizePath("widget-dep")),
    script = "dep.js"
  )
)
```
